sections.text: Every AI product starts with a prompt. A vague idea, typed into a box, and a hope. Then the model updates. The output drifts. And production breaks.
This is Bedrock. Intelligence, shaped by you.
Describe what you want. Bedrock asks the right questions, then synthesizes a production-grade system prompt. Structured. Constrained. Ready to ship.
Chain prompts on a visual DAG canvas. Route conditions, merge consensus, orchestrate entire agent workflows.
Then prove it. Benchmark side by side across ten frontier models, with live latency and token telemetry.
